summary: Immuron Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its Appendix 4E preliminary final report for the year ended 30 June 2026 and a results presentation. The filing discloses annual results: revenue up 5.9% to A$7.71M, net loss reduced 26.4% to A$3.84M, cash of A$9.02M, and no dividends. No special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic reviews are present. The filing is a routine periodic results report by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a standard earnings release, not triggering any special-situations category.
